During the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]], this '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''', under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], was dispatched to the [[Rishi moon]] to support the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]]. He was destroyed by [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]]

==History==
When [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces planned an attack on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], some [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] were sent to the [[Rishi moon]] to take out the outpost. The droids were successful until the arrival of [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] and [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]]. The droid commander and his forces were sent to the moon to support the commando droids. After successfully driving back the clones, the station was conquered. Unfortunately for the commander, shinie [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] stayed behind and shot the commander's head off with his [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] while trying to reach the liquid tibanna to blow the station up.<ref name="Rookies" />
